context:
Entirely fictional case. All people, identifiers, contact details, decisions and signatures are synthetic and do not represent a real submission.
Fictional 40-year-old female inpatient returns from travel on 18 October 2026, develops fever/headache/myalgia 21 October after freshwater exposure, and has serum plus paired urine collected 23 October and sent 24 October. No pregnancy, ITU/dialysis, post-mortem or suspected HG4. Previous reference is P26C000909, represented in its eight native independent digit widgets. Every native date digit widget is separately represented; ordinary whole NHS/reference fields are not split.
